clusterNodes.description: Set to true to cluster nodes within a certain radius.

showClusterCount.description: When set to true, the cluster shows the number of nodes in the cluster.

radius.description: Cluster radius in pixels. All nodes within this radius are grouped into the same cluster.

minNodes.description: The minimum number of nodes required within the same radius to form a cluster.

clusterSize.description:
The enlargement factor to scale node clusters by. When configured, all node clusters will be displayed as
the same size instead of being dynamically sized by the number of nodes in the cluster.

clusterDonutConfig.description:
The configuration to set a donut around a clustered node based on the aggregration of the specified
property in the constituent nodes.

If no property is specified or {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeClusterDonutConfig#donutType} is not set, no
donut will be rendered around the clustered node.

If {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeClusterDonutConfig#donutType} is set to 'percentage', a single donut sized
by the average of the value specified at {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeClusterDonutConfig#fieldName} is set.

If {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeClusterDonutConfig#donutType} is set to 'segments', multiple donut segments
sized by the count of the unique values specified at {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeClusterDonutConfig#fieldName}
are set.

title:
The configuration for clustering nodes within a certain pixel radius when
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualization#showMap} is true.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeClusterConfig
